description:
Our moduledoc claims pi-mono parity (\"any trailing incomplete event in the buffer is silently dropped, matching pi-mono's semantics\") — but pi-mono's iterateSseMessages (anthropic.ts:343-353) actually flushes any pending event/data on EOF. Latent false errors if a server closes without a trailing blank line.

Add \`SSE.finalize/1 :: {[Event.t()], t()}\` that:
1. If the buffer still has non-empty content without a terminating newline, appends \\n and decodes one final line.
2. Calls the existing \`flush\` logic to emit any pending event/data.
3. Returns {events, state} with an empty buffer.

Producer calls it after Req.post! returns cleanly, before emit_done_or_error.

TDD:
- RED: two failing SSE tests — (a) \"stream ending with 'data: payload\\n' (no blank line) emits the pending event\", (b) \"non-empty buffer at EOF without newline flushes after finalize\".
- GREEN: implement finalize/1, call from Producer.
- REGRESSION: also fix the moduledoc claim to reflect the new behavior.

Files: sse.ex, sse_test.exs, producer.ex, docs/port-map/anthropic.md (§3 needs updating).
title: SSE.finalize/1: flush pending event on clean EOF (pi-mono parity)
